Introducing Orbit-7: a 34B open model for coding agents

Today we are releasing Orbit-7, an open-weight model with 34 billion parameters, built for coding agents and tool use.

Orbit-7 supports a context window of 256,000 tokens and scores 71.2% on SWE-bench Verified.

At 4-bit precision, Orbit-7 runs on a single 48GB GPU. The full-precision (FP16) weights need about 68GB.

Through our API, Orbit-7 is priced at $0.40 per million input tokens and $1.60 per million output tokens.

Weights are available today under the Apache 2.0 license.
